name: Open a door or drawer
description: Open an annotated articulated door or drawer so its interior can be accessed.
requires: The named part has an annotated handle and open joint target.
The gripper is free for handle manipulation.
A collision-free pose for reaching and moving the handle can be found at execution time.

outcomes.success: The part reaches its annotated open joint target within the skill's tolerance.
outcomes.failure: The handle cannot be reached or grasped, or the part does not reach the open target.

verifier.evidence: The function checks the measured joint value against the annotated open target.

connections.when: The chosen object is behind the opened door or drawer.
The target surface is inside the opened appliance or furniture.
Access is finished and the same part should be closed.
